_about: Public-domain John L. Dagg (1794-1884, Baptist, president of Mercer University) for the Word Hoard: Manual of Theology in its two parts (Christian Doctrine; Church Order; Charleston, 1859), The Elements of Moral Science (1860) and The Evidences of Christianity (1869), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
